title: snapshot.end
description: server → host and clients. Marks the end of the state snapshot sent after room.created, room.joined or room.resumed. Until it arrives the receiver should build state silently (no animations, no haptics).

serverTimeMs.description: Server clock when the snapshot was completed.

lastOutcomeSeq.description: Sequence number of the newest entry in the room outcome log; 0 when the log is empty.

TimeMs.description: Absolute time on the server clock: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Every `…AtMs` field in the protocol uses the server clock (see Clock).
